title: When Kids Become Accused Killers and Criminals
description:
Nearly ten percent of crime is committed by minors in the United States every year. Law enforcement officers are not strangers to dealing with kids and crime, sometimes even murder. Watch six times police arrested kids for allegedly murdering someone or committing other crimes on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
